artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan fixing the --global FTS5 over-constraint via sanitize_query() hardening, a single-process multi-query rank-merge search mode, filtered-term briefing rewiring, new global-mode regression coverage, real-corpus verification, and FTS5 semantics documentation.

memory_candidates.content: When a recall fix requires fanning one query out into N sub-queries, the naive shape (N invocations of the existing search CLI, merged by the caller) directly re-creates the per-invocation process/IO cost that perf work elsewhere is eliminating -- especially when each invocation opens a large DB and reloads an index/metadata map. The decomposition that satisfies both goals is to push the fan-out loop INSIDE the existing single expensive process (one DB open, one metadata load, N cheap MATCH executions) and expose it as an additive CLI mode, while keeping the cheap per-item preprocessing (sanitization) in the outer layer so its existing implementation stays the single source of truth rather than being duplicated into the inner process.
